geography: Worldwide (single printed geography row per quarter; U.S. in most quarters, Global/ROW where so labelled)
moa: Combination of three monoclonal antibodies against the Zaire ebolavirus glycoprotein

launch_evidence.note: No filing names a commercial launch; sales are government procurement. launch_quarter is the approval quarter, the earliest a sale could occur; the first net product sales Regeneron prints are in 2022Q3 (Form 10-Q for the quarter ended September 30, 2022: 'Inmazeb - U.S. | 3.0 | —', the prior-year column a printed nil).

series_start_reason: Regeneron's net product sales tables carry no Inmazeb row before the third quarter of 2022 (searched every Regeneron 10-Q, 10-K and Item 2.02 8-K from 2020-10-01); the 2022Q3 10-Q prints 2021 comparatives as nil. Before then Inmazeb revenue was BARDA development funding recognised in other revenue (2020 Form 10-K: 'recognition of revenue in connection with our agreement with BARDA related to funding of certain development activities for Inmazeb'), not product sales. 2022Q3 is seven quarters after the 2020Q4 approval.
series_end_reason: Regeneron's Forms 10-Q for the quarters ended March 31, June 30 and September 30, 2026 (e.g. https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/872589/000087258926000016/regn-20260331.htm) print no Inmazeb row in the net product sales tables; Inmazeb appears only in the trademark list and the product/indication table. The fourth-quarter 2025 release (exhibit991q42025.htm) is the last to print 'Inmazeb - U.S.'.
search_log: Listed every filing for CIK 872589 (Regeneron) via data.sec.gov/submissions; searched every 10-Q, 10-K and Item 2.02 8-K (all documents per filing) from 2020-10-01 to 2026-11-03 for 'inmazeb'.

Q1-Q3 read from each quarter's own Form 10-Q net product sales table (one decimal); Q4 from the fourth-quarter earnings release (whole millions), the only filing that prints the fourth quarter as current.

Regeneron labels the single Inmazeb row by where the period's sales occurred ('Inmazeb - U.S.', '- Global', '- ROW'); only one Inmazeb row is printed each period, so each row is the product total and the series is one scope (total net product sales).
